resolutions.cause: Table layout retained and shaped a complete row before publishing its first fragment, so stopping at first-page publication was too late.
resolutions.change: The existing LayoutRun supports a first-page-only run from the section start. Complete shared column-width measurements and full-document layout are preserved.
